steps: Register a student online for an info session, then scan their QR code 2 minutes after start.
expected_result: Check-in saved and linked to the registration; attended count for the event rises by 1.
actual_result: Accepted; linked to registration 3043; event attended count 32 -> 33

steps: Look up a rostered student with no registration and check them in.
expected_result: Check-in saved with no registration; walk-in count for the event rises by 1.

steps: Check in a student who is already checked in to the event.
actual_result: Rejected: UNIQUE constraint failed: checkins.event_id, checkins.student_id

steps: Register a student again for an event they are already registered for.
actual_result: Rejected: UNIQUE constraint failed: registrations.event_id, registrations.student_id

steps: Submit a registration with the email 'student.university.example'.
expected_result: Rejected by the email format check.
actual_result: Rejected: CHECK constraint failed: contact_email LIKE '%_@_%._%' AND contact_email NOT LIKE '% %' AND contact_email NOT LIKE '%@%@%'

steps: Check in student ID S999999, which is not on the roster.
expected_result: Rejected (student must exist on the roster).
actual_result: Rejected: no check-in was saved, and S999999 is not on the roster

test: Reject a check-in outside the event window
steps: Check in a student 3 hours before the event starts.
expected_result: Rejected with 'Check-in time is outside the event window'.
actual_result: Rejected: Check-in time is outside the event window

steps: Fill an event to capacity with online registrations, then add one more.
expected_result: Registrations up to capacity are Registered; the next one is Waitlisted.
actual_result: Capacity 40, 23 already registered; added 18: last one is Waitlisted, others ['Registered']

steps: Cancel an active registration that has no check-in.
Record a follow-up as sent 2 days after its due date.
expected_result: Follow-up report shows Sent late, 2 days past due.
actual_result: Status Sent late, 2 days past due

steps: Clear the sent date on a follow-up that is past due.

test: Detect a duplicate in imported data

expected_result: Duplicate report lists a Confirmed group: 'Same email, different capitalization'.
actual_result: Confirmed, 2 rows, Same email, different capitalization

steps: Compare blank student IDs in the legacy registration sheet with the exceptions log and the data-quality report.

steps: Look up 200 students (every ninth on the roster) for an event's check-in screen, on an in-memory copy of the database.
expected_result: Each lookup returns in under 2 seconds.
actual_result: 200 lookups took less than 1 ms in total (the clock counts whole milliseconds)

test: Reject a registration for an unknown student
steps: Register student ID S999999, which is not on the roster.
expected_result: Rejected (student must exist on the roster).
actual_result: Rejected: no registration was saved, and S999999 is not on the roster

test: Block editing a check-in time outside the window
steps: Change an existing check-in time to two days after the event started.
expected_result: Rejected with 'Check-in time is outside the event window'.
actual_result: Rejected: Check-in time is outside the event window

test: Cancelled registration cannot be checked in against
steps: Check in a student against their cancelled registration, then as a walk-in.
expected_result: Link to the cancelled registration is rejected; the walk-in check-in is accepted.
actual_result: Linked to cancelled registration: Rejected: Registration does not match this event and student, or is not active. As walk-in: Accepted
